description:
Software Developer – IoT Applications 
 Position Summary 
DENSO is seeking a highly motivated Software Developer to join the IoT Team and support the design, development, and maintenance of enterprise and manufacturing-focused software solutions. This role will be responsible for building scalable, high-quality applications that support connected systems, operational visibility, process automation, and smart manufacturing initiatives.
The ideal candidate will have experience with Microsoft development technologies, including the .NET framework/ecosystem, as well as modern front-end development using Angular. This position requires strong collaboration with cross-functional teams to deliver secure, reliable, and user-friendly solutions that align with business and plant operational needs.
**An updated resume is required for consideration**
 Key Responsibilities 
• Design, develop, test, and deploy software applications that support DENSO IoT and smart manufacturing initiatives.
• Develop front-end applications using Angular and related web technologies such as HTML, CSS, TypeScript, and JavaScript.
• Build and maintain back-end services, APIs, and business logic using .NET / C#.
• Work with Microsoft development tools such as Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, SQL Server, Git, and related Microsoft platforms.
• Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, analysts, and infrastructure teams to gather requirements and deliver technical solutions.
• Support integration between IoT platforms, enterprise systems, databases, and manufacturing applications.
• Create and maintain technical documentation, including design specifications, support documentation, and deployment procedures.
• Troubleshoot application issues, perform root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions.
• Participate in code reviews and follow established coding standards, security requirements, and development best practices.
• Support software lifecycle activities including enhancements, bug fixes, testing, release management, and production support.
• Contribute to continuous improvement efforts for software quality, team processes, and development efficiency.
 Required Qualifications 
• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or related field, or equivalent work experience.
• Experience in software development using Microsoft technologies.
• Strong experience with C# and .NET / .NET Core development.
• Experience developing web applications using Angular.
• Proficiency with Visual Studio, Azure DevOps, Git, and related Microsoft development tools.
• Experience with REST APIs, web services, and system integrations.
• Experience working with SQL Server and relational databases.
• Strong understanding of software design principles, debugging, testing, and version control.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills.
 Preferred Qualifications 
• Experience supporting IoT, manufacturing, MES, industrial, or connected device environments.
• Knowledge of Azure cloud services and cloud-based application development.
• Experience with Power BI, data visualization, or operational reporting solutions.
• Familiarity with microservices architecture and scalable application design.
• Experience working in an Agile / Scrum development environment.
• Understanding of cybersecurity, authentication, and secure application development practices.
• Experience integrating with manufacturing systems, shop floor applications, or enterprise platforms.
 Technical Skills 
 Required 
• C#
• .NET / .NET Core
• Angular
• TypeScript
• JavaScript
• HTML / CSS
• SQL Server
• Visual Studio
• Azure DevOps
• Git
• REST API development
 
 Preferred 
• Microsoft Azure
• Entity Framework
• IIS
• JSON / XML
• CI/CD pipelines
• IoT data platforms or device integrations
 Core Competencies 
• Problem solving and analytical thinking
• Strong attention to detail
• Collaboration and teamwork
• Initiative and accountability
• Continuous improvement mindset
• Customer/service orientation
• Adaptability in a fast-paced technical environment
 Work Environment / Role Focus 
This role supports DENSO’s digital manufacturing and IoT strategy by delivering software solutions that improve visibility, automation, data integration, and operational efficiency. The Software Developer will work closely with internal stakeholders across IT, engineering, and manufacturing teams to develop solutions that meet business and operational objectives.
 Benefits Summary: 
    • Medical, Dental, Vision, Prescription Drug Plans
    • 401K with 4% Company Match
    • Vacation/PTO and 13 Paid Holidays
    • Bonus Program
    • FSA/HSA and Dependent Care Programs
    • Company provided Life, Disability, ADD, and Business Travel Insurance
    • Various No Cost Wellness & Chronic Condition Management Programs
    • Various Optional Insurance Programs such as Legal, Identity Theft, Critical Illness, etc.
    • Tuition Reimbursement
    • Career Development and Ongoing Training
    • Employee Assistance Program
    • Employee Spotlight and Recognition Program
    • Volunteer opportunities
    • Onsite Fitness Center (vary by location)
    • Cafeteria and food markets (vary by location)
    • Onsite Health Clinic and Pharmacy (vary by location)

Candidates residing 50+ miles from the work location are eligible for relocation assistance.
Annual Salary: $73,000 - $92,000
